policy: All AI visuals are illustrative historical reconstructions or conceptual illustrations, not documentary photographs or evidence of supernatural events. Do not depict an identifiable real traveler, witness, face, quotation, book cover, readable signage, or exact unverified event. The traveler is a generic anonymous silhouette only. Former Taman Festival is represented as a historical reconstruction before its 2026 redevelopment, not present-day footage. Renderer overlays REKA ADEGAN • ILUSTRASI AI; never ask the image model to render text. Match the EP02 Balinese Gothic Documentary master style.

art_direction.name: Balinese Gothic Documentary • Etching + Charcoal + Dark Oil Painting
art_direction.palette: charcoal black, deep volcanic stone grey, aged sepia, muted antique gold, restrained dark maroon, subtle moss green
art_direction.texture: aged archival paper, etched cross-hatching, charcoal grain, painterly oil texture, weathered stone

art_direction.cultural_respect: Balinese architecture and cultural objects must be depicted respectfully and contextually. Do not use poleng cloth, masks, offerings, shrines, or sacred figures as shorthand for evil. No invented ritual scenes or sacred iconography used as horror props.
art_direction.allocation: 2 engraving/etching scenes, 2 charcoal scenes, 2 dark gothic oil painting scenes
